sentences: The terminal sends SessionRequest, waits for SessionAccept, and then enters the active state.
If the network never answers, the terminal stays in the idle state.
During the active state it sends a keep-alive message every ten seconds.
A missing keep-alive answer is counted as a failure.
After three failures the session is released.

requirements.text: The terminal shall send a SessionRequest message.
The terminal shall wait for a SessionAccept message after sending the SessionRequest message.
The terminal shall enter the active state after receiving the SessionAccept message.
If the network never answers, the terminal shall stay in the idle state.
During the active state, the terminal shall send a keep-alive message every ten seconds.
A missing keep-alive answer shall be counted as a failure.
After three failures, the session shall be released.
